answer: Referral-tree kin detection roots each account in a sponsor whose shared pigment marks both: linked recruits pay zero, and fan-out past the branching ratio is taxed convexly. So N clones cannot pool one lineage, since disjoint sponsors need separate histories, each a distinct vine of non-reusable trust, and each marginal meadow clone costs more than the last through the convex tax, driving attacker cost super-linear in N.
